text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI (calculated): 29.8

text:
Age: 58
Sex: M

31.4

text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Component            Value     Date
BMI                  31.4      08/13/2026
note: A result table row: the value is 31.4 and the trailing number is a date.

name: bmi-flagged-high
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI 31.2 (H)
note: An abnormal flag must not change which number is read.

name: bmi-in-vitals-run
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Vitals: BP 138/82, HR 72, BMI 31.2, Temp 98.6 F, SpO2 98%
note: A run-on vitals line: BMI is 31.2, not the heart rate or temperature.

name: bmi-obesity-category-not-a-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Problem List:
  Obesity (BMI 30.0-34.9)
  Essential hypertension
note: An obesity CLASS descriptor is a range, not a measurement, so BMI stays blank.

name: bmi-height-weight-only
text:
Age: 38
Sex: Male
Height 5'10"  Weight 190 lb
note: Height and weight without a BMI must not produce one; neither 5, 10 nor 190 is a BMI.

name: bmi-height-weight-metric-with-bmi
text:
Age: 38
Sex: Male
Weight 86 kg, Height 1.75 m, BMI 28.1
note: With metric height and weight present, the labeled BMI still wins.

name: bmi-questionnaire-with-height-weight
text:
Age: 38
Sex: Male
Height 5'10"  Weight 190 lb  BMI 27.3
note: Intake form line: the BMI is the labeled 27.3.

name: bmi-blank-dashes
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI: --
Total chol: 200
note: A wildcard placeholder is missing data.

name: bmi-not-on-file
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI: not on file
Total chol: 200
note: An explicit missing-data phrase is not a value.

name: bmi-percentile-pediatric
text:
Age: 30
Sex: F
BMI 21.4 (85th percentile)
note: The percentile in parentheses is not the BMI.

name: bmi-trend-prior-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI 31.2 (was 33.1)
note: The current value leads; the prior value sits in a parenthetical.

name: bmi-bsa-not-bmi
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BSA 1.9 m2
Total chol: 200
HDL: 45
note: Body surface area is a different measure; BMI stays blank.

name: bmi-ibw-not-bmi
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
IBW 70 kg
Total chol: 200
HDL: 45
note: Ideal body weight is not a BMI.

name: bmi-implausibly-low-ignored
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI: 8
note: A BMI of 8 is not physiologically plausible and is rejected rather than passed to the form.

name: bmi-high-but-real-parses
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI: 45.2
note: 45.2 is outside the model's validated range but is a real measurement; it parses so the form can flag it, rather than being silently dropped.

name: bmi-integer-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI: 27
note: A whole-number BMI.

name: bmi-list-most-recent-first-differs
text:
Age: 74
Sex: male
BMI: BMI Readings from Last 3 Encounters:
09/10/26 : 21.35
06/23/26 : 26.00
note: When the readings differ, the most recent (first) one is taken - this is the case that made the original bug visible, since 21.35 and 26.00 give different risks.

name: bmi-label-then-lab-table-no-bmi
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI:
Cholesterol, Total,*     197
Cholesterol, HDL, P*     37
note: An unfilled BMI label followed by a lab table must not swallow the cholesterol as a BMI.
